d: Watch as Firstpost breaks down a jaw-dropping, high-stakes gold scam in Kampala where a serving Ugandan army major allegedly promoted himself to 'General' to fleece a Dubai-linked investor out of a staggering $2.4 million. With Uganda's gold exports surging to a record $5.8 billion and overtaking coffee as the nation's biggest export earner, the General Court Martial has remanded three suspects—including a private security boss and a businessman—over charges of obtaining money by false pretences and scandalous conduct. Firstpost dives deep into the shadow networks of regional gold…
